name: Draw or Judge
desc:
🎨 Welcome to Draw or Judge!
A game where you present or judge works of art!

🖌️ Every round a theme and a judge will be chosen. You will have time to create your masterpiece and...
💀 If the judge doesn't like your drawing... you'll be eliminated!

🥸 Draw or Judge, Speed Draw, Draw or Die, Draw or Oof, Free Draw, Draw Murder

❗ FREE Custom Themes are available on Private Servers!

👍 Like and favorite the game!
📱 Supports Desktop, Mobile and all other platforms!
